relationships.subject: bupivacaine
relationships.evidence_quote: Biochemical findings reveal suppression of microglia M1 polarization, elevation of microglia M2 polarization, and inhibition of the HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB inflammatory axis in the spinal cord dorsal horns of CCI rats that had undergone preventive treatment with bupivacaine.

relationships.subject: bupivacaine
relationships.evidence_quote: microglia M1 polarization-related Interferon Regulatory Factor 5 (IRF5) and P2X Purinoceptor 4 (P2X4R) mRNA were detected in the ipsilateral side 7 days after CCI, with the changes being alleviated in CCI rats upon bupivacaine treatment (Figure 3A)

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: HMGB1, a nuclear DNA-binding protein, is an endogenous ligand of TLR4.

relationships.subject: bupivacaine
relationships.evidence_quote: The relief of pain paralleled with the suppression of microglia M1 polarization, elevation of microglia M2 polarization, and inhibition of IRF5/P2X4R and HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB

key_findings: Preventive intrathecal bupivacaine reduced CCI pain behaviors and suppressed M1 microglia, IRF5/P2X4R and HMGB1/TLR4/NF-κB in dorsal horn and sciatic nerve.
